components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Emerald action such as Sign in or Save settings.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-accent, oklch(73% 0.16 160)); color: var(--color-accent-ink, #03150d); font: 500 14px/1.5 "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-accent, oklch(73% 0.16 160)) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, oklch(73% 0.16 160)); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action such as New conversation or the model chip.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-outline"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>New conversation</button>

components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-soft, #1c1c1c); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--color-surface, #111111); font: 500 13px/1.5 "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a, .ds-nav button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; height: 28px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink-muted, #a1a1a1); font: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { background: var(--color-surface-raised, #1b1b1b); color: var(--color-ink, #fafafa); } .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { background: #202020; color: var(--color-ink, #fafafa); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-rule, #262626), 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4); } .ds-nav button { cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, oklch(73% 0.16 160)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-badge { padding: 0 6px; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #262626); border-radius: 999px; font-size: 10px; }

components.css: .ds-reading { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; padding: 0 12px; font-family: "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-reading + .ds-reading { border-left: 1px solid var(--rule-soft, #1c1c1c); } .ds-reading-label { color: var(--color-ink-muted, #a1a1a1); font-size: 11px; line-height: 13px; } .ds-reading-value { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; color: var(--color-ink, #fafafa); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-meter { width: 28px; height: 4px; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--color-rule, #262626); overflow: hidden; } .ds-meter i { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--color-accent, oklch(73% 0.16 160)); } .ds-stale .ds-reading-value { color: var(--color-warning, #fbc56a); } .ds-stale .ds-meter i { background: var(--color-warning, #fbc56a); }

components.css: .ds-card { width: 320px; padding: 20px 20px 0; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #262626); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-surface, #111111); color: var(--color-ink, #fafafa); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 35%), 0 8px 24px -14px rgb(0 0 0 / 50%); font-family: "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card h2 { margin: 0 0 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-label { margin: 0; color: var(--color-ink-muted, #a1a1a1); font-size: 12px; } .ds-card-figure { margin: 4px 0 12px; font: 500 24px/1.25 "Geist Mono Variable", ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-bar { height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-surface-raised, #1b1b1b); overflow: hidden; } .ds-bar i { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--color-accent, oklch(73% 0.16 160)); } .ds-card footer { margin: 16px -20px 0; padding: 10px 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #262626); color: var(--color-ink-muted, #a1a1a1); font-size: 11px; }

components.css: .ds-tools { max-width: 720px; color: var(--color-ink-muted, #a1a1a1); font: 400 13px/1.5 "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tools summary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #262626); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--color-paper, #0a0a0a); cursor: pointer; list-style: none; } .ds-tools summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-tools summary:hover { background: var(--color-surface-raised, #1b1b1b); } .ds-tools summary svg { color: var(--color-accent, oklch(73% 0.16 160)); } .ds-tools summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, oklch(73% 0.16 160)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tools small { font-size: 11px; } .ds-tools pre { margin: 8px 0 0; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #262626); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-surface, #111111); color: var(--color-ink, #fafafa); font: 400 12px/1.65 "Geist Mono Variable", ui-monospace, monospace; overflow-x: auto; }

components.name: Assistant Composer
components.description: Docked single-line composer with model chip and circular send.
components.css: .ds-composer { width: min(100%, 720px); padding: 12px 12px 10px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #262626); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--color-surface-raised, #1b1b1b); box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgb(0 0 0 / 30%), 0 18px 40px -16px rgb(0 0 0 / 70%); transition: border-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color: var(--color-rule-strong, #444444); } .ds-composer textarea { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 32px; max-height: 180px; resize: none; border: 0; padding: 2px 0 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink, #fafafa); caret-color: var(--color-accent, oklch(73% 0.16 160)); font: 400 15px/1.55 "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; } .ds-composer-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-chip { height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink-muted, #a1a1a1); font: 500 12px/1.5 "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--color-paper, #0a0a0a); } .ds-send { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-accent, oklch(73% 0.16 160)); color: var(--color-accent-ink, #03150d); cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:focus-visible, .ds-send:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, oklch(73% 0.16 160)); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.northStar: Readings in the header, answers in the center
narrative.overview:
Voidstation uses a near-black app shell, compact Server readouts, and familiar workspace controls. The confirmed direction is archived at `prototype/voidstation-redesign:prototypes/redesign-worlds/hybrid.html`, with Linear and Vercel dashboard craft and ChatGPT/Claude conversation conventions. Keep the reading area quieter than the header and controls. No cinematic treatment or catalog motif.

The Assistant puts saved conversations in a sidebar and answers in a centered column. The Dashboard uses the same shell without the sidebar. On phones, history becomes a modal drawer and workspace navigation moves below the composer. These are implemented layouts, not a new brand metaphor.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only, with charcoal panels and thin rules.
Existing emerald for actions, live readings, links, and focus.
Original Sora logo; Geist reading text and Geist Mono measurements.
Grouped tool evidence, soft corners, and limited offset shadows.
dos: Do retain the exact emerald, original logo, self-hosted fonts, and dark-only palette.
Do keep Assistant reading at 15px/1.7, bounded by 72ch, with evidence available on demand.
Do use the existing slot components, protected overlay focus, 44px touch targets, and reduced-motion rules.
Do pair reading-state colors with words or icons and retain observation details.
donts: Don't add Sora headings, uppercase eyebrows, decorative imagery, or colored glow.
Don't restore the three-column boxed Assistant workbench or add a sidebar to the Dashboard.
Don't style Controls/Soon as available or describe read-only tool activity as a mutation or approval.
Don't remove focus, selection, caret, scrollbar, IME, or keyboard-resize behavior when reusing the layouts.
